claim.claim: From 1 March 2024, gains on the disposal of unlisted shares by companies, limited liability partnerships, trust bodies and co-operative societies are subject to tax under the Capital Gains Tax regime.
claim.entity: companies, limited liability partnerships, trust bodies and co-operative societies

results.evidence_quote: Effective from 1st January 2024, company, limited liability partnership, trust body and co-operative society which receives gains or profits from the disposal of capital asset consisting of:. 1. share of a company incorporated in Malaysia not listed on the stock exchange; or.

claim.claim: For unlisted shares acquired on or after 1 March 2024, the tax is 10% on the gain or 2% on the gross disposal price, whichever is higher.
claim.entity: companies, limited liability partnerships, trust bodies and co-operative societies
claim.value: 10% on the gain or 2% on the gross disposal price, whichever is higher

results.reason: The official pages do not settle this claim.

claim.claim: For unlisted shares acquired before 1 March 2024, a lower rate of 2% on the gain applies, subject to conditions.
claim.entity: companies, limited liability partnerships, trust bodies and co-operative societies

results.reason: The official pages do not settle this claim.
